name: Trello
tagline: Visual kanban board for task and project management
verdictSummary: A kanban board is drag-and-drop columns with cards. That's a CRUD app with a drag-and-drop library (dnd-kit). Add card details, checklists, due dates, and labels. The core loop — create columns, add cards, drag between columns — is trivially one-shot buildable.
coreLoopDIY: Drag-and-drop kanban board with columns, cards, checklists, and labels
whatYouLose: Power-Ups (Butler automation, calendar view, timeline view)
Advanced checklists with due dates and assignees
